rows.reason: a strip whose own animation loops a translate for ever (the motion inventory's record, never a name) is a marquee, the block chosen by what its items show and where it sits: logos alone make sgs/brand-strip; labels, alone or each with an icon or an image, make sgs/trust-bar when its item fields hold every kind the items show (array_item_schema roles: icon-slug or svg, image-object, text-content) and the section block fits where the strip sits; otherwise sgs/brand-strip showing the names as text. A section block (block_composition.container_kind section, as sgs/trust-bar) never sits inside another section, and sits only in a slot that gives it its full width: a header row, the footer's top row, a drawer's, modal's or mega panel's body, any slot the draft lays out as one full-width child (it spans its parent's content box through every ancestor up to the surface root or the section root that holds only its slot blocks, and no sibling sits beside it); never a slot that lays its children out as columns (the footer's column and bottom rows) and never a page section's own container. The marquee motion and the widths it runs at are the motion writer's (sgsMotion, belowBreakpoint), and the repeated items are its items (Bean, 2026-10-31)
